notes: Sweden has no national duty rota and no regional duty-rota pages were found: night/weekend cover is organised by the chains (Evidensia, AniCura) and by Distriktsveterinärerna's county on-call, which is a phone standby service, not a published rota table. 11 entries count as 24 h after independent check on 2026-11-03: 8 staffed 24-h small-animal hospitals (Bagarmossen/Stockholm, SLU UDS/Uppsala, Malmö, Helsingborg, Strömsholm, Gammelstad/Luleå, Sundsvall, Östersund) and 3 Distriktsveterinärerna phone on-call entries (Gotland, Vimmerby, Västervik) whose pages state round-the-clock vet availability explicitly and list dogs/cats. Distriktsveterinärerna Öland (Färjestaden): page says a vet is reachable around the clock but does not state that small animals are covered, so it is listed as a clinic with emergency_24h false. Notably NOT 24 h despite assumptions: Göteborg (Evidensia Göteborgs Djursjukhus to 24:00, AniCura Västra to 21:00), Linköping (Valla to 23:00, Jägarvallen to 20:00), Kungens Kurva to 22:00, Växjö, Jönköping, Kalmar, Hässleholm, Karlstad, Örebro, Västerås, Gävle. Poison line: none. No animal poison line found; Giftinformationscentralen serves humans, and Agria's sjukvårdsrådgivning is included for Agria insurance customers (not stated to be open to the public), so it is not listed. Sites not usable: svf.se (bot check page), jordbruksverket.se/sva.se. Not used: PrivatVet / vetsverige / allaveterinarer / eniro (aggregators); Skellefteå and Umeå clinics only on PrivatVet. Left to research: Umeå and Skellefteå clinics via their own sites, other Distriktsveterinärerna county on-call pages (Norrbotten, Jämtland, Västerbotten, Skåne etc.), Uppsala district DV on-call, tourist-area clinics (Åre, Dalarna, Bohuslän coast), Sörmland, Kristianstad, Halmstad, Borås, Skövde, Trollhättan, and Stockholm night options outside Bagarmossen. Follow-up 2026-11-03 (feat/M6-K-vets-se-followup): added 40 entries; 21 are Distriktsveterinärerna phone on-call entries (explicit 'dygnet runt' text plus dogs/cats on the clinic page; not staffed hospitals). DV county pages for Norrbotten, Västerbotten, Jämtland, Dalarna, Södermanland, Uppsala and Skåne checked; DV Umåker (Umeå) refers acutely sick animals to Vännäs and Haparanda/Vilhelmina pages carry no on-call text, so they are not 24 h. Still unresearched or unreachable: Borås, Trollhättan town clinics, Skövde/Halmstad night options (none found; Skövde refers to Alingsås Djursjukhus), Umeå Lapplands/Djurkliniken i Umeå own pages (not reachable, only aggregator found), Stockholm night options beyond Bagarmossen (none found; Nacka emergency to 20:00, Alvik to 21:00, Farsta to 21:00), AniCura Katrineholm/Strängnäs/Södertälje/Ängelholm pages (WebFetch refused), DV Brunflo/Sveg/Överkalix/Rimbo/Haparanda-adjacent pages, Bohuslän coast and Åre beyond Åre Djurklinik (no 24-h found), Gotland/Öland already covered.
